name: talesreach
description: Talesreach — free browser MMORPG for phone and PC

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently -n server,client "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p tests --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace shared && vitest run
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
